author: potuz
content:
I don't care about the type of txs, I assume that running KECCACK in a loop would be the most CPU consuming? Maria, Carlos and Toni would be perhaps the right ones to ask. What I want to test is how does the chain attest when payloads finish executing **after** the PTC has voted available, and even better if we can  make them cross into the next slot cause that **should never** happen. 

That is, just to make it clear, a very patological case is a payload that is voted early by the PTC and at the same time does not finish executing until the next slot.
